data.body: **[P1] Keep parent completion atomic through aggregate checkpointing.** The lock is released before `handleCompletion`, allowing a late child rejected by `persistChildCompletion` to cache and mark its outcome while map/parallel scans its branches. A late `PayloadOffloadException` explicitly classified as skipped can consequently be observed and rethrown by result assembly, aborting the already-winning early completion; ordinary late results can also replace `SKIPPED`. Hold the lock through aggregate construction/checkpoint publication, or snapshot and exclude every child rejected after the completion claim, with a blocked-completion race test.
